statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because current evidence does not verify persistent one-way NQ structure; event stress remains high ahead of the U.S. cash-open and Jackson Hole data-and-policy cluster.

headline: Low Tail, high event stress ahead of Warsh
body: Delayed September NQ was 29,646.75 at 03:42 UTC after trading 29,595.25–29,672.75, while Reuters reported Nasdaq futures about 0.1% lower amid mixed Asian markets. Treasury yields were steady and oil eased. The evidence supports high event stress but not persistent one-way Tail structure.
